package.name: cpptoml_vendor
package.description: Builds the header-only cpptoml TOML parser (skystrife/cpptoml v0.1.1) and installs its cmake config, so iceoryx_posh can consume it via find_package(cpptoml) with DOWNLOAD_TOML_LIB=OFF instead of its inline ExternalProject download (which runs host git/doxygen that fail under the VxWorks SDK). Must build before iceoryx_posh.
